title: God HARDENS hearts: The ultimate manipulation? #shorts

top_liked.author: @JPBurn-g5t
top_liked.text:
Precisely 💁
A. Why does God interfere with the Pharaoh's free will?
B. Why does God punish the innocent people of Egypt and not the Pharaoh?

top_liked.author: @ancientmysticalhealing5791
top_liked.text: I had a discussion about this with my mom and she couldn’t believe that’s what it said so she grabbed a concordance or commentary that explained it was Pharoh who hardened his own heart and not god. Said that was the way they wrote back then. I couldn’t finish the conversation…

top_liked.author: @robercoli6136
top_liked.text:
Darante, I just watched your full video on Exodus. The question of Pharaoh's heart was always asked of me by non-believers when I was a believer. Of course, my answer was always just, "It was God's will/plan etc."
This is a great discussion to have with believers now. 
Thank you…

top_liked.author: @workathomestoners9154
top_liked.text: I saw this a long time ago and saw how this God is impossible, you have no choice and no will but the authority of God who made you do it in the first place! NO REASONING OR SANITY HERE!

top_liked.author: @rarebreed9208
top_liked.text:
With christianity, we just can't win, and God never loses.
 Life is like being trapped in a casino where the house always wins.

top_liked.author: @randallpickering9944
top_liked.text: I always hated the punishment for people that had no participation in the events. Killing the first-born, even the animals, isn't just or loving. It's a model of original sin, with punishment for all humans because a woman (of course) ate a piece of fruit.

top_liked.text: This is part of the many contradictions in the Bible as well.... In some verses, God hardens pharohs heart. In other verses, pharoh hardens his own heart. Then theres the claim that "God is not tge author of confusion..." Tell that to the 700 contradictions within the Bible. 😂
